claims.raw_snippet: At the beginning of 2026, a pilot for credit card payments will launch on Egged bus lines in Eilat, Jerusalem, and Haifa. This option is an additional solution designed to make boarding easier, especially for passengers who don't have a Rav-Kav card or a payment app available at that moment.
